purpose: Explicit native forward-tool geometry for an analogue pin-adhesion fixture; not a source-exact Emerson fixture reconstruction.

publication_protocol.machine: Instron model 1122 UTM, Series IX software
publication_protocol.dimension_orientation_relative_to_MD_CD: not stated for this pin specimen

pin_series.selected_facing: bottom liner; article says the remaining corrugated structure stays with the other pin series

unreported_fixture_geometry: pin pitch and lateral registration relative to flute tips
pin end shape and engagement length
individual test specimen caliper and moisture state
publication_protocol.kinematic_interpretation: The published 12.5 mm/min platen approach is treated as the relative opening rate. The prototype shares that displacement symmetrically between two stationary-in-other-axes platen pin sets, an explicit modeling choice.

digitized_observable.slide_15: Two illustrative load-displacement traces labeled White Glue Lines and Applicator roll too fast; the displayed curve window is partial and does not show the zero-displacement origin.
digitized_observable.slide_16: Summary markers for pin adhesion work/stiffness versus strength. Work axis prints N-m; the value is preserved as an unresolved source-axis number.
digitized_observable.article_to_slide_value_correspondence: not established point-for-point; never duplicate or merge article figure digitization with presentation-pixel data
digitized_observable.article_and_presentation_independence: same study context and likely overlapping specimen cohort; do not treat as independent datasets

engineering_prototype_geometry.pin_shape_interpretation: one round-ended capsule bar per alternating pin, with its long axis spanning the specimen length
engineering_prototype_geometry.relative_opening_symmetry: each pin set moves half the relative opening in opposite z directions
engineering_prototype_geometry.prohibited_interpretation: chosen geometry values are not Emerson fixture dimensions, TAPPI tolerances, or measured/certified inputs

source_limits: No raw force-displacement file is available; slide 15 is a sparse visual estimate from a presentation plot.
The article describes six specimens per defect type, but the slide traces do not identify specimen IDs or link to individual article replicates.
The article's plotted/data summary and presentation plots are kept as distinct source artifacts; any exact figure-to-figure correspondence remains unresolved.
Pin-adhesion response is a whole-fixture specimen observable and does not identify local starch traction, GIc, GIIc, or mixed-mode parameters.
Article sample orientation and crosshead displacement registration for the presented partial plot are not available; do not fit a free displacement offset to claim material calibration.
